syllabus: Unit 3 teaches 〜ます, 〜ません, 〜ました, 〜ませんでした, 〜を, 〜へ／〜に, 〜で (place), 〜で (tool), 〜ましょう and 〜ませんか: is this a fair N5 set in a sensible order, given that some items already use まだです (unit 5), noun + に行きます (unit 6) and 〜が meaning 'but' (unit 7)?

n5u03d1.d1: Made-up verb forms appear as wrong options and watch sentences across the unit (飲むます, するます, 見るません, 食べますでした, 言きます in t.4). Acceptable as distractors?
n5u03d1.d2: Answer します (テニスを　します). Are the wrong options, especially きます, too obviously wrong?
n5u03d1.d4: Answer 見ません (テレビをあまり見ません). The explanation says あまり goes with a no ending, in the 'not much' sense. Accurate enough for N5?
n5u03d1.d5: Star item; the tiles split the verb from its ending (おき／ます). Too easy?
n5u03d1.d6: Star item; the tiles split the verb from its ending (行き／ません). Too easy?
n5u03d1.e3: Star item (先生は　あした　午前十時に　来ます). Too easy?
n5u03d1.k: Words on this day that may be above N5: よてい (scene title 一週間のよてい), れいぞうこ, テニス, そうじ, デパート. Fine?
n5u03d1.k1: Made-up readings and spellings as wrong options: らいじゅう here, せいえん, ちえん (day 2), 雨車, 電東, 雨東 (day 3), こご, ごこう (day 4). Clearly wrong and acceptable?
n5u03d1.r1: Answer 友だちと　えいがを　見ます. It comes right after いいえ、行きません. Too easy for a listening item?
n5u03d2.d2: Answer 見ませんでした. Option 見ないでした is counted wrong (the watch note calls it non-standard), though heard in casual speech. Fair?
n5u03d2.d6: Star item (どこへも行きませんでした). どこへも and 何も + a no ending are not taught. Fair here, and not too easy?
n5u03d2.e3: Star item (先週の　日よう日、友だちの　うちへ　行きました). Too easy?
n5u03d2.k: Receipt scene and day words: 駅前店, 二本, デパート, スーパー, カレー, たまご, しゅくだい. Fine for N5?
n5u03d3.p1: The watch note: 毎日コーヒーが飲みます (wrong) → コーヒーを飲みます. Clearly wrong to a native?
n5u03d3.d5: Star item (新しい本を読みました). Too easy?
n5u03d3.d6: Star item (母と新しいデパートへ行きます). Too easy?
n5u03d3.e2: Answer かえります (らいげつ　くにへ　かえります). Natural, with くに for one's home country?
n5u03d3.e3: Star item (父は　きのう　大きい　魚を　買いました). Too easy?
n5u03d3.k: Platform scene: 行き read ゆき, 大学前 is a made-up station name, and 午前. Also えいが and らいげつ in today's items. Fine?
n5u03d3.r1: Answer きっぷ (きっぷが先ですよ). The script uses まだです (unit 5). Natural, and not too close to unit 2 day 1's はじめに listening?
n5u03d4.p1: The watch note: 学校でとしょかんがあります (wrong). It says あります takes に for place; events (学校でパーティーがあります) are not mentioned. Fine for N5?
n5u03d4.e3: Star item (学校で何を食べましたか). Please confirm 学校を何で食べました is clearly wrong.
n5u03d4.r1: Answer 学校の　前の　こうえん. The passage uses しょくどう and こうえん. Fine for N5?
n5u03d5.p2: The watch note marks いいえ、しません (to an invitation) as wrong, though it is only cold. Fair to mark it wrong?
n5u03d5.c1: Rewritten after the check (options ませんか / ました / ましょうか, answer ましょうか). Please read once. Is 何時に会いませんか clearly wrong?
n5u03d5.d5: Star item (いっしょに山へ行きませんか). Too easy?
n5u03d5.e3: Star item (花見に　行きませんか). Noun + に行く comes in unit 6, and 花見 may be above N5. Fair here, and not too easy?
n5u03d5.k: Poster scene: 休み means the event is cancelled if it rains. Natural on a poster?
n5u03d6.d2: Rewritten after the check (母は月よう日と木よう日にデパートではたらきます). Please read once. Is はたらきます natural for a regular job (はたらいています is not taught)?
n5u03d6.d3: Answer ませんか (つめたいジュースがありますよ。飲みませんか). Is いただきます a natural reply?
n5u03d6.d5: Star item (駅の中のきっさてんで会いませんか). Close in shape to day 5's d6. Too similar?
n5u03d6.d6: Star item (うちに父の会社の人が来ました). It tests the unit's grammar only lightly. Keep?
n5u03d6.e1: Answer 買いませんでした (行きましたが、何も　買いませんでした). 〜が meaning 'but' comes in unit 7. Fair here?
n5u03d6.k: Notice-board scene: けいじばん (title), 休み時間, 来月, and きょうしつ in the reading. Fine for N5?
n5u03t.6: Answer きのう (Sunday; tomorrow is Tuesday). Is the date logic quick enough for an N5 item?
n5u03t.17: Star item (父の　古い　カメラで), ★ on 古い. It relies on 古い not describing 父. Clear enough?
n5u03t.18: Star item (あの　大きい　木の　下で). Please confirm no second order works.
n5u03t.21: Answer 一時に　一かい. The passage uses センター and いりません. Fine for N5?
n5u03t.22: Answer うたの　クラス; the cooking class ends exactly at 二時半, when Anna becomes free. Clear enough? ひま is not taught.
